name: Other Fish to Fry
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Renamed from Other Fish to Fry . From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... my crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades.

The naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me.

Me conscience can't handle the guilt, champion; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?
narrative.objectives: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText: As sweet as it is hearing the news that the naga have been vanquished, my heart still feels empty. For the rest of my life I will be dedicated to having them all killed.Here mon, your reward as I promised. It's small in comparison to the gratification of knowing the naga fried for their hated act upon my crew.
narrative.requestItemsText: I still hear their voices crying for help when the naga unleashed their chaos over us. If I didn't have this bad knee, I'd go and help you kill those blasted naga!You can usually guarantee to find them deep in the coral reefs below the surface... lurking... scheming...
